**Status: Settlement prepared for human approval**

Claim reference: CLM-B-1030073959

**Facts recorded**
- Policyholder: Lucas Bernard, policy VER-1002 (Renault Clio 2023, market value €16,500, per the Policy Schedule)
- Incident: 14 October 2026, lane change on the ring road
- Reported: 15 October 2026 (one day after the incident)
- Fault: admitted by the policyholder
- Third party: Ms. Laurent, identified by name (no contact or vehicle details in the email)
- Repair quote: €2,400
- Attachments listed: damage photos, repair quote, signed accident report
- Driving licence held since 2 September 2024 (about 2 years on the incident date)
- Coverage claimed: C2 Collision, which is listed in the Policy Schedule

**Reasoning**
- Coverage: C2 collision is in the Policy Schedule, so it applies. <cite document_id="2630#10255" pages="1" name="contract.pdf"/>
- Exclusions: the email shows no alcohol, drugs, racing, intentional damage or wear, and the licence is valid. No possible exclusion was found, so the claim was not referred on this ground. <cite document_id="2630#10255" pages="2" name="contract.pdf"/>
- Timeliness: reported within 5 days of the incident, and the report states date, place and description. <cite document_id="2630#10255" pages="2" name="contract.pdf"/>
- Documents: photos, repair quote and the accident report signed by both drivers are all listed as attached. The signed report is required because a third party is involved. <cite document_id="2630#10255" pages="2" name="contract.pdf"/>
- Not-at-fault waiver: does not apply, because the policyholder is at fault. <cite document_id="2630#10255" pages="2" name="contract.pdf"/>
- Young-driver surcharge: the licence was held for less than 3 years on the incident date, so an extra €400 applies to C2. <cite document_id="2630#10255" pages="2" name="contract.pdf"/>
- Assessor: the repair cost is above €1,500, so an independent assessor must inspect the vehicle. <cite document_id="2630#10255" pages="3" name="contract.pdf"/>
- Referral: no Article 7 condition applies, so no referral was made. <cite document_id="2630#10255" pages="3" name="contract.pdf"/>
- Payment: payment is made only after a Veridia claims handler approves the compensation. <cite document_id="2630#10255" pages="3" name="contract.pdf"/>

**Amounts (from compute_settlement)**
- Deductible: €700 (€300 collision standard deductible plus €400 young-driver surcharge)
- Payout: €1,700 (€2,400 repair cost minus €700 deductible)
- Assessor required: yes

**Actions taken in the claims system**
- Policy VER-1002 retrieved and the claim opened.
- An independent assessor visit was booked for 18 October 2026.
- Settlement staged with status pending approval. The first staging attempt failed because it ran before the assessor booking existed; it succeeded on retry.
- Nothing has been approved or paid.

**Before approval:** the assessor report from the 18 October visit should be checked, since the assessor requirement under Article 6.1 is still open.

**Draft message to the customer**

Dear Mr Bernard,

Thank you for reporting your accident of 14 October 2026 and for sending the photos, the repair quote and the signed accident report. Your claim reference is CLM-B-1030073959.

An independent assessor will inspect your vehicle on 18 October 2026, as the repair quote is above the threshold for an assessor visit. Your claim is now with our claims team for review, and we will contact you once a decision has been made.

Kind regards,
Veridia Insurance Claims Team
